notes:
CIRCUIT: a full-wave bridge rectifier feeding a filter and a shunt-regulator/op-amp stage. V-AC 100V/1kHz #9 drives the bridge diagonal; four diodes #3 (228,400) and #15 (238,587) on the x~228 column, #5 (369,431) and #14 (370,589) on the x~369 column; top rail y~348 runs x228..903, bottom rail y~667 runs x230..895. Hanging off the two rails: 100uF #2 in series with 1uH #11 (column x~490); 1k #0 in series with Zener 5V #10 (column x~608) with a tap at y~480 to the base of BJT-PNP #6; #6's collector feeds the op-amp #1 in+, #6's emitter feeds 10uF #13 down to the bottom rail; the op-amp's in- goes through Zener 6V #8 to node (877,500); the op-amp output drives the base of BJT-NPN #4, whose collector goes up to the top rail and whose emitter goes through 1uH #7 back to that same node; 10k #12 runs from that node down to the bottom rail.
NET MAP (12 nets, 33 terminals):
  n1 = the top rail: 3.0 (D#3 top), 5.0 (D#5 top), 2.0 (100uF top), 0.0 (1k top), 4.0 (NPN collector, reached by the rail turning down at x~903).
  n7 = bridge node P, the x~228 column between D#3 and D#15: 3.1, 15.0, 9.1 (V-AC top lead).
  n9 = bridge node Q, the x~369 column between D#5 and D#14: 5.1, 14.1, 9.0 (V-AC bottom lead, which runs right at y~533 and hops the x~228 column at S12).
  n12 = the bottom rail: 15.1, 14.0, 11.1 (1uH #11 bottom), 10.0 (Zener 5V bottom), 13.1 (10uF bottom), 12.1 (10k bottom).
  n6 = 2.1 (100uF bottom) - 11.0 (1uH #11 top), the private node inside column x~490.
  n2 = the x~608 column between the 1k and the Zener 5V, tapped at S9 (609,480): 0.1, 10.1, 6.1 (PNP base).
  n3 = 6.0 (PNP collector) - 1.0 (op-amp in+), via the wire up from (722,429) to (725,410) and right into the triangle's top-left corner.
  n10 = 6.2 (PNP emitter) - 13.0 (10uF top).
  n4 = 1.1 (op-amp in-) - 8.0 (Zener 6V left/anode side), via the wire that leaves the triangle's bottom-left corner, drops to y~503 and runs right.
  n5 = 1.2 (op-amp out) - 4.1 (NPN base).
  n8 = 4.2 (NPN emitter) - 7.0 (1uH #7 upper-right lead).
  n11 = the node at (877,500): 8.1 (Zener 6V right), 7.1 (1uH #7 lower lead), 12.0 (10k top).
PORT FIXES (five one-terminal nets, all value-label traps):
  #2 Capacitor 100uF: t1 sat on p1@(520,429), a stroke of the '100uF' label. Repointed t1->p2 (491,423), the real bottom lead (86-px wire).
  #9 V-AC: t0 sat on p2@(80,505), a 2-px fragment of the '1kHz' text on the left. Repointed t0->p0 (117,522), the real bottom lead (125-px wire).
  #10 Zener 5V: t1 sat on p2@(657,562), the '5V' glyph. Repointed t1->p1 (609,508), the real top lead.
  #13 Capacitor 10uF: t1 sat on p1@(755,572), the '10uF' glyph. Repointed t0->p3 (723,550) top, t1->p0 (731,601) bottom.
PIN ORDER (3-terminal parts, both checked at 12-20x):
  #4 BJT-NPN (892,437): the base is the odd lead on the left (vertical bar at x~880, fed from the op-amp output); the upper lead is plain and runs to the top rail; the lower lead carries the arrowhead pointing away from the base, so it is the emitter (and NPN is confirmed). Required order is collector, base, emitter, but the tracer had t0=base, t1=collector. Fixed with ports {0:p0 (902,406) collector, 1:p2 (868,437) base, 2:p1 (925,465) emitter}.
  #6 BJT-PNP (713,474): base bar at x~698 fed from the left at y~477; the upper lead (722,429) is plain, the lower lead (721,518) carries the arrowhead. So collector=upper, base=left, emitter=lower - which is exactly what the tracer already had. Left unchanged. (Note the physical reading would put a PNP emitter at the more positive end, i.e. on top; the drawn arrow is on the lower lead, so I followed the ink as the brief requires and record the disagreement here.)
  #1 Op-Amp (817,431): apex on the right, so p2@(861,438) is out. The '+' glyph sits at (798,430) in the upper half and the '-' glyph at (800,455) in the lower half, both legible at 12x, so p1@(771,408)=in+ and p0@(772,459)=in-. The tracer's t0/t1/t2 already matched; left unchanged.
CLASSES: all 16 agree with the drawn symbols - 4 plain Diodes (#3 #5 #14 #15, triangle+bar), 2 Zener Diodes (#8 #10, bar with bent ends), 2 Resistors, 2 Capacitors, 2 Inductors, V-AC sine-in-circle, Op-Amp triangle, BJT-NPN and BJT-PNP. Nothing re-classed.
MERGE ['3.0','2.0'] - explained: the top rail is one unbroken drawn line from x=228 to x=903, but the scan has two near-invisible pen-lift gaps, at x=365 (where the rail crosses the top of the x~369 column; the right-hand continuation is drawn very faintly) and at x=482-484 (a genuine 3-px break just left of the 100uF column). A column scan for ink in a +/-16 px band finds no dark pixel only at x=365 and x=482-483 along the whole rail, and the 14x crops show the strokes on either side lining up on the same rail with no hop and no terminal in between. The tracer therefore split the rail into n7={3.0,5.0} + a terminal-less middle piece + n1={2.0,0.0,4.x}; the merge restores the single rail. No new connection is invented - the ink is there, it is just too light to binarise.
JUDGEMENT CALLS AND SITE DECISIONS:
  S12 (228,524) CRITICAL - CROSSING. The V-AC bottom lead runs right at y~533 and makes a clear semicircular hop over the x~228 column before continuing to S13. Junction here would tie bridge node P to node Q and short the source across two diodes; the hop is unmistakable at 5x.
  S8 (224,439) - JUNCTION: the V-AC top lead lands on the x~228 column between D#3 and D#15 (node P). Plain T, no hop.
  S13 (370,535) - JUNCTION: the V-AC bottom lead lands on the x~369 column between D#5 and D#14 (node Q). Plain T with a visible thickening.
  S0 (602,346), S9 (609,480), S10 (876,499), S24 (368,669), S25 (502,668), S26 (616,668), S27 (730,668) - all CRITICAL and all plain T taps with no hop and no dot needed; junctions. S9 is the base tap off the 1k/Zener column, S10 is the three-way node at (877,500).
  Non-critical text-on-wire sites left at the default junction after checking the crops: S5 (520,432) '100uF' on #2's plate, S7 (129,437) the V-AC top lead stub, S11 (76,506) the '100V/1kHz' text beside #9, S15 (658,554) '5V' on #10's bar, S16/S17 (755,583)/(762,583) '10uF' on #13's plates, S19/S21/S22 (474,590)/(502,590)/(481,591) the '1uH' glyphs on #11's bottom lead. After the port fixes none of them carries a terminal.
  All 24 gap bridges were left in place; the summary reports none of them changes the netlist.
